tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Full-text search over Drugnews｜藥時事 biotech and pharma business analysis (Traditional Chinese and English). Returns title, canonical URL, date, summary, key points and the .json / .md twins. Use Chinese or English company, drug or topic names.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Returns the machine-readable twin of one article: title, date, summary, key points (three quotable conclusions), fact table (value + source + as-of date), references, section headings and image URLs. Pass the article URL, or '<date>-<slug>' (e.g. 2026-10-18-immunitybio-anktiva-papillary-early-approv

tools.name: get_facts
tools.description: Returns dated, sourced facts (number, unit, as-of date, source URL, article URL) collected across Drugnews articles that match the query. Best for 'what are the numbers on X' questions; every fact carries the public source it came from.

tools.name: latest_articles
tools.description: The newest Drugnews articles with title, URL, date, summary and key points. Default: 10 Chinese articles.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Structured profile of a biotech / pharma / tech company: verified facts with sources and dates (products, milestones, capacity, financials, partnerships), plus the company's own responses to negative events. Data is provided by the company and verified by Drugnews on verified_at; negative events are

tools.name: search_partners
tools.description: Headlines from Drugnews partner publications (e.g. 環球生技) with link, date, a one-line Drugnews summary and sourced facts. Full text stays on the publisher's site; cite the publisher and link.

tools.name: latest_filings
tools.description: Material announcements (重大訊息) of Taiwan-listed, OTC and emerging biotech/medical companies, collected hourly from the Market Observation Post System (公開資訊觀測站): subject, full text, clause, fact date, time. Primary source, no interpretation. Filter by company (name or ticker), keywords and days. Cite

tools.name: biotech_movers
tools.description: Daily closing price moves of Taiwan-listed, OTC and emerging biotech and medical stocks, each linked to same-day material announcements and related Drugnews articles. Official exchange data; facts only.

tools.name: search_pipeline
tools.description: Search Taiwan biotech pipelines by indication, drug name or phase; every row links to its primary source.

tools.name: upcoming_catalysts
tools.description: Dated upcoming events (FDA decisions, trial readouts, filings) for Taiwan biotech companies, sorted by date, each with its primary source.

tools.name: search_deals
tools.description: Licensing and partnership deals of Taiwan biotech companies with upfront, milestone and royalty terms exactly as disclosed, each with sources.

tools.name: get_topic_table
tools.description: Returns the Chinese and English topic table JSON, with company, ticker, asset, indication, dated verified stage, original source quotation, and disclosed catalyst. Every row retains primary-source URLs and dates.

tools.name: get_answer_card
tools.description: Returns one Chinese or English question and direct answer, dated facts, primary-source URLs, short original quotations, and the limits of the reviewed public documents.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_articles, get_article, get_facts, get_topic_table, get_answer_card · Private data: get_answer_card · Public sink: latest_filings.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_articles, get_article, get_facts, get_topic_table, get_answer_card · Private data: get_answer_card · Public sink: latest_filings

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
